alergična: alergičan — allergic; nom. case fem. sg.
bih: conditional, 1st pers. sg.: voleo bih — I would like
boli: boleti; 3rd pers. sg.; boli me dupe — I don't care (rudely)
brinite: brinuti — to worry; imperative 2nd pers. pl.
broj: noun masc.; broj poena — number of points
da: conjunction: that, so that; da + verb = infinitive («da vidim» — to see); also «yes»
dan: noun masc.; dobar dan — good afternoon
dati: verb; ja ću vam dati — I'll give you
dišite: disati — to breathe; imperative 2nd pers. pl.
dobro: dobro veče — good evening; dobro je što — good thing that
dopisao: dopisati — to add (in writing); past masc. sg.
doselila: doseliti se — to move (here); past fem. sg.
dosta: adverb: quite a lot; dosta dobro — quite good
dođem: I will get there, I will arrive
doći; 1st pers. sg.: doći do — to get to
evo: evo ga — here he is; evo nas — here we are
ga: short form of njega; «ili ti ga» — «or, in other words» (colloquial)
hvala: hvala vam puno — thank you very much
i: conjunction; before the word — «and, also, even»
idem: ići — to go, to ride; 1st pers. sg.
izašla: izaći — to go out; past fem. sg.
javila: javiti se — to show up, to make contact
je: biti — to be, 3rd pers. sg.; auxiliary verb past; je l' — «really, or what»
jesi: biti, 2nd pers. sg., full form; in questions: jesi siguran? — you're sure?
ka: preposition + dat. case: ka selu — toward the village
kašalj: mačji kašalj — a piece of cake (lit. «cat cough»)
kažem: kazati — to say; 1st pers. sg.; da kažem — let's say
kod: preposition + gen. case: kod znaka — by the sign; kod Marija — at Mario's
kući: kuća — house; idemo kući — we're driving home
legla: leći — to lie down; past fem. sg.
lični: lični — personal; nom. case masc. sg.
ljubaznim: ljubazan — kind; instr. case masc. pl.
mislim: misliti — to think; as an introductory word — «I mean, that is»
mogu: moći — to be able; 1st pers. sg. (also 3rd pers. pl. — «they can»)
mora: morati — to be supposed to; 3rd pers. sg.
moram: morati — to be supposed to; 1st pers. sg.
na: preposition: na jugu — in the south, na Instagram — in Instagram
napisaću: napisati — to write; 1st pers. sg., future
nego: brže nego što — faster than; pre nego što — before
nekih: neki; za nekih nedelju dana — in about a week
nema: nemati — not to have; nema znaka — there is no sign
nemamo: nemati — not to have; 1st pers. pl.
nije: negation of je: nije selo — this is not a village
ništa: at the beginning of a sentence — «well then, anyway»
od: preposition + gen. case: jedno od naselja — one of the settlements
odmarajte: odmarati se — to rest; imperative 2nd pers. pl.
ozdravite: ozdraviti — to get well; imperative 2nd pers. pl.
pa: particle at the start of a line — «well»; conjunction — «and, therefore»
padne: pasti — to fall; pre nego što padne mrak — before it got dark
pijte: piti — to drink; imperative 2nd pers. pl.
pila: piti — to drink; past fem. sg.
plaši: plašiti se — to be afraid; 3rd pers. sg.
po: po mraku — in the dark; po jedan — one by one; dva i po — two and a half
ponesite: poneti — to bring; imperative 2nd pers. pl.
posao: noun masc.; na posao — to work
poslušala: poslušati — to listen, to obey; fem.
poslušao: poslušati — to listen; past masc. sg.
postajao: postajati — to become; past masc. sg.
pozvala: pozvati — to call; past fem. sg.
pregledam: pregledati — to look through; 1st pers. sg.
preko: preposition + gen. case: preko reke — beyond the river; preko puta — opposite
puno: hvala puno — thank you very much
puta: put — road, way; gen. case: preko puta — opposite, across the road
razboljela: razboleti se — to fall ill; past fem. sg.
razumela: razumeti — to understand; past fem. sg.
red: noun masc.; doći na red — to reach (about the queue)
redu: red — row, queue; na redu — next in line
sa: preposition + instr. case; + gen. case — «with, from» (sa mape — from the map)
sad: = sada; e sad — well then, so
sam: biti, 1st pers. sg.: rekao sam — I said
se: reflexive particle: slikamo se — we take photos of ourselves
skuvala: skuvati — to cook; past fem. sg.
stajala: stajati (nekome) — to go, to suit; lepo ti stoji — it suits you
ste: biti, 2nd pers. pl.: što ste tu — what are you doing here
su: biti, 3rd pers. pl.: sela su — villages — this…
sve: sav — all; neut. sg. or pl.
ti: pronoun; «ili ti ga» — «or, in other words» (colloquial)
topli: topao — warm; nom. case masc. sg.
u: preposition: + loc. case — where, + acc. case — where to
ujutru: u šest ujutru — at six in the morning
umornim: umoran — tired; instr. case masc. sg.
upitala: upitati — to ask; past fem. sg.
uzdahnula: uzdahnuti — to sigh; past fem. sg.
uzimajte: uzimati — to take; imperative 2nd pers. pl.
vas: short/full form acc. case of vi
već: adverb «already»; after negation — «a» (nije selo već gradić)
vidim: I see; to catch sight of
videti — to see; da se vidim s njim — to see him
virusna: virusni — viral; nom. case fem. sg.
vratite: vratiti se — to come back; imperative 2nd pers. pl.
za: preposition: za to — for this; skretanje za — turn onto
zdravstvenu: zdravstven — health (adj.); acc. case fem. sg.
znači: značiti — to mean; as an introductory word — «so, in short»
ćete: hteti; aux. verb future, 2nd pers. pl.
